# beszel_system (Data Source)

Looks up a single existing Beszel system by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "beszel_system" "example" {
  name = "web-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) PocketBase record ID of the system. Exactly one of id or name must be set.
- `name` (String) Display name of the system. Exactly one of id or name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Hostname or IP address the agent connects from.
- `info` (String) Agent-reported system info, as a raw JSON string.
- `port` (String) Agent port.
- `status` (String) Agent-reported status: up, down, paused, or pending.
- `users` (List of String) IDs of Beszel users who own this system.
